task: P5 RULING P5-01(iii) — inv5 absorbs resolved escalations
before: inv5 counted resolved escalations twice: fixed_n counted the FIXED fix row AND escal_fix counted the same finding as an escalation -> '498 UPHELD/MODIFIED != 498 FIXED fixes + 22 escalations' (498 != 520) HIGH.
after: inv5 now computes fixed_n = |need_fix_ids ∩ fixed_ids| (distinct-finding basis, robust to multi-loop rows); an ESCALATE-path finding whose fix rows include a terminal FIXED is ABSORBED (resolved-escalation), counted once as fixed; only escalations WITHOUT a FIXED fix count as open_escalations. Reconciliation: need_fix_n == fixed_n + open_escalations. A distinct resolved-escalations (and open-escalations) counter is threaded via an optional stats out-param and printed in the summary line.
evidence: Real data: need_fix_n=498, fixed_n=498, resolved_escalations=22 (all 22 escalations carry a terminal FIXED; open=0) -> 498 == 498 + 0 GREEN. Summary line reports 'resolved-escalations=22 open-escalations=0'. Set relationships verified: fixed_ids ⊆ need_fix_ids; 0 need_fix satisfied by neither. Self-test p5_pass (resolved-escalations==1) + p5_fail_escalation (loop-3 NOT-FIXED, no escalation file -> inv1+inv5 HIGH) green.
